source.provenance: Drafted by an AI model for the course ladder in contemporary Bokmål (2005 norm); not reviewed by a native speaker. It is controlled, deliberately repetitive Norwegian written for learners and may contain unnatural phrasing. Facts about Norway and Bergen are general knowledge and unchecked. The English lines are the drafter's own.

review.notes: Machine-drafted by an AI model; awaiting native-speaker review. House style: moderate Bokmål with three genders (ei/-a for feminine nouns, en/-en masculine, et/-et neuter), weak past in -et, neuter definite plural in -ene, sju and tjue, "ble", "ga". Everyone uses "du" (the polite "De" is rare in modern Norwegian and is not taught). "Hyggelig" alone is the short form used in Stage 0. "fru" is written with a lower-case f.

sentences.english: Sam is in town. Here is Mrs Berg.
